notes.title: DLC trains available. New free update: Wellbeing
notes.content:
Hello Urbekites,

After a lot of work the trains DLC is finally available

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696580/Urbek_City_Builder__Trains/

[list]
[*] Fire station: with a fire truck
[*] Pharmacy
[*] Urban forest
[*] Mental Health Center

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/37ffc15e9830a544ada0dccb225846ea53aa5368.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/b13d33fd922ae72c80394f7e2f3211b3dc7e0f76.png[/img]

notes.title: We're working on a new DLC! Urbek available on Switch and Xbox!
notes.content:
Hello Urbekites,


We are excited to announce that our team is hard at work developing a new DLC for Urbek City Builder. We have been taking feedback from the community and working to create new content that we believe our players will love.

[previewyoutube=YSfRNUfM6u0;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to this exciting news, we are thrilled to announce that Urbek City Builder is now available on both the Nintendo Switch and Xbox consoles! We know that many of our fans have been eagerly waiting for this release, and we are happy to finally bring our game to even more players.

Our team has been working tirelessly to optimize the game for these platforms, ensuring that players can enjoy the same great experience on the go or at home on their console of choice.

[h2]Check now:[/h2]

[h3][list]
[*] [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/urbek-city-builder-switch/]NINTENDO SWITCH[/url] 
[*] [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/urbek-city-builder/9mw2mr3gv8dd]XBOX SERIES X/S[/url]
[/list][/h3]




We want to thank our fans for their continued support and patience as we work on the new DLC. We can't wait to share more details about it in the coming weeks, and we hope that our players will enjoy the new content that we are creating.

Thank you for playing Urbek City Builder, and we'll be back with more updates soon!

notes.title: First DLC - Defend the City Released! Plus Free Map Editor and 30% discount!
notes.content:
Hello urbekites,

Finally after a lot of hard work I can tell you that a free game update is available for everyone to edit their own maps to make the city of your dreams!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/9479a64ed8a2b02b0fcdfbfa8b175dad116c354a.gif[/img]

In addition, the DLC has been released that brings 2 new biomes with new models, rules and new mechanics.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1411740/Urbek/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215480/Urbek_City_Builder__Defend_the_City/

[b]Mountain[/b]: There is no way to get food with farming, food will be missing and all your builds are frozen. Get resources from the mountains

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/3a5006a96adf438dbd2f41378eaf55cbad92d0a2.png[/img]

[b]War[/b]: Your city is being bombed, create defences, build up your army and defend your city from bombing.

On top of that, there is a 30% discount on the game and 10% on the DLC!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/b1b87454f0d86dcf844a340498728fda4bdd58f3.png[/img]

If you want to participate in deciding the future of Urbek, we are waiting for you in the discord community!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/HyJSDDn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png[/img][/url]

And thank you very much for all the feedback!

notes.title: Soon new DLC: Defend the city
notes.content:
Hello Urbekites,
Soon you will be able to play a new DLC for Urbek: Defend the City with 2 new biomes.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2215480/Urbek_City_Builder__Defend_the_City/

[h3]War[/h3]
Build military facilities to be able to defend against enemy bombings. Increase the range of your defences so you can expand without fear of being destroyed by bombardment.

[b]Incremental bombardment[/b]: The attacks will get stronger and stronger and you will need better defences if you don't want to lose parts of your city.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/eea3bc2cacbfed8f8db60133ebed2641101af6e3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/2376de4b6095903663f6f5a69c998638990db227.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/01d6626c3ea84cc7af5b81b81da6b1fd6d0ef748.png[/img]

[h3]Mountains[/h3]
Food is hard to come by in a frozen world. Give it a try! Although the snow will bring new tourism options, such as ski slopes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/6252d8fb5c79719fa67a8877448af5cfde9019fa.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/ee0faef6a71af984067988e5dcab0dc30786c47c.png[/img]

In the discord I ask players different things to decide together about updates to the game, what new biomes to add, new features, ett, so join the discord
[url=https://discord.com/invite/HyJSDDn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39262571/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 🚀Released game 🚀 Urbek is available now !!!
notes.content:
Hello Urbekites,

After years of work I can finally tell you: [b]the game is ready[/b] for you to enjoy!

[list]
[*] Play on 5 different biomes
[*] Discover over 200 buildings
[*] 1000 unique voxel models
[/list]
Thank you so much for the support of the community, you have helped me a lot to make the game what it is now. Good ideas, bugs found, suggestions, etc.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1411740/Urbek/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/6bbad2523a57d499b656376c50ef57eeb19b56f9.png[/img]

I will keep listening to the community as I have done so far to keep an eye on how you want the game to evolve, so stay tuned ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/f8090f459600f58177e54a18ec3e0fa0ee4a5224.png[/img]

If you want to share your scores, give ideas or participate in any other way, join the discord community:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/HyJSDDn][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/c68e33a949adffa14b71a4c36aae9be0389d88bf.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: 🚀 Release date Reveal !!! Urbek will be available on July 13th 🚀
notes.content:
Hello Urbekitas,

The big release day of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1411740/Urbek/]Urbek: City Builder[/url][/b] is coming up, July 13th! Thank you very much for your feedback, it will always be essential for us to make the game together.

In less than a month you will be able to play the full version of Urbek: City Builder! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/6bbad2523a57d499b656376c50ef57eeb19b56f9.png[/img]

It's been a lot of work to get this game. There are 5 different levels, more than 200 types of constructions and 1000 different models, from the 10 different models of stilt houses to the 4 cyclists that you will see riding in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41649607/546cd9d720050705acbcab0f22a0bf8058873219.png[/img]
